title: Can a helpful bonus change the goal?
hook: Two routes earn different rewards. Add a hint along one route.

knows: A grid world: an agent moves, collects points, ends at a goal.
doesNotKnow: Distinguish an arbitrary reward bonus from a potential-difference shaping rule that preserves these route rankings.

objective: Distinguish an arbitrary reward bonus from a potential-difference shaping rule that preserves these route rankings.
misconception: Every helpful-looking bonus preserves the best route.
